name: app-icon-ring-geometry
description: Verification: read the app-icon grid's live computed geometry (track width, button border box, image box) alongside a capture, so the ring fix is confirmed by arithmetic and not only by eye.

actions.note: gate: the startup tab committed, so the app is up
let the window build and its route load
select the pane by its id, not by a coordinate the rail layout can move

actions.expression: (() => { const icons = document.querySelector('.settings-app-icons'); const on = document.querySelector('.settings-app-icon.on') || document.querySelector('.settings-app-icon'); const img = on.querySelector('.settings-app-icon-img'); const neighbour = on.nextElementSibling; const iconsStyle = getComputedStyle(icons); const onStyle = getComputedStyle(on); const onRect = on.getBoundingClientRect(); const imgRect = img.getBoundingClientRect(); const neighbourRect = neighbour ? neighbour.getBoundingClientRect() : null; return JSON.stringify({ trackWidth: parseFloat(iconsStyle.gridTemplateColumns.split(' ')[0]), boxSizing: onStyle.boxSizing, padding: onStyle.paddingLeft, border: onStyle.borderLeftWidth, btnWidth: onRect.width, btnHeight: onRect.height, imgWidth: imgRect.width, imgHeight: imgRect.height, imgInsetLeft: imgRect.left - onRect.left, imgInsetTop: imgRect.top - onRect.top, imgOverflowRight: imgRect.right - onRect.right, imgOverflowBottom: imgRect.bottom - onRect.bottom, gapToNeighbour: neighbourRect ? neighbourRect.left - onRect.right : null }); })()
actions.note: the measured box model, not a guess from the stylesheet
the ring on the marked tile, for a look alongside the numbers
